source.title: Natural Earth 1:10m Land
source.processing: Physical land polygons clipped to bbox, unioned to remove source tile seams, topology-preserving simplification 0.0008 degrees, six decimal coordinates.
source.purpose: Historical generalized geographic illustration; not current coastline, legal boundaries, or street-level geometry.
source.clip_edge_note: Straight segments at the bounding box are crop edges, not coastlines.
